decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line remains closely aligned with the firm's established natural facial-care know-how and multi-item in-house development capabilities, so management is likely to keep refining it rather than withdraw it.

The hyaluronic acid serum builds on existing skincare formulation and ingredient-sourcing knowledge, allowing the firm to learn from market feedback and improve it with relatively low adjustment cost.

The facial cleansing oil is still close enough to the firm's core facial-care expertise for the firm to absorb early lessons and iterate, but as a newer launch with less visible commitment than A it faces a somewhat higher withdrawal risk.
